profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I enjoy building systems that solve challenges while reducing the complexity of software and improving maintainability. My background is in security research but in recent years I have gravitated toward writing software for SaaS businesses.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development on the Delta One automated futures trading team
- Low latency (nanosecond scale) code in C/C++
- Connections to new exchanges, hardware acceleration of performance critical applications
- Research pipeline and configuration using Python
positions.insights: Skills: Low Latency Trading · Python · C++ · C · Performance Tuning · Computer Networking

positions.title: Staff Architect
positions.description:
Software development and architecture for the document subsystem
- Storage, retrieval and search of the most important business data: legal documents
- Design and implementation of systems to manage complexity during a rapid growth phase
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · Elasticsearch · Software Architecture · Distributed Systems · Cassandra · Kotlin · Apache Kafka · Terraform · Microservices · Docker · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development on the Safe Browsing malware detection system
- Highly distributed infrastructure scanning millions of URLs per day
- Research and development of malware detection and anti-cloaking methods
- Operational rotation ensuring global availability and reliability
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · C++ · Distributed Systems · Malware Analysis · NoSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description: Leading a team writing server-side Java and Scala code for a robust message archiving system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Java server development in a highly concurrent and fault tolerant message archiving system.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I studied under Dr. Carl Gunter in the Illinois Security Lab.  My research related to healthcare IT security, vulnerability research and general system security.
positions.insights: Skills: Cybersecurity · Research Skills · Machine Learning

company.name: The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

positions.title: Graduate Vulnerability Research Intern
positions.description: Vulnerability research using modern tools and methods including fuzzing, static analysis, dynamic analysis, virtualization, debugging and much, much more.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Reverse Engineering · Malware Analysis

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Providing support for Cerner Millennium including memory dump analysis, network analysis, developing debugging tools, and working closely with clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · C++ · Reverse Engineering
